_help: One entry per tile. Save the file and reload the page: no restart needed.
name, url: required. In url, {domain} is replaced by DASHBOARD_DOMAIN from .env (keeps your domain out of git).
group: section heading. description: small text under the name.
icon: a file in ../www/icons/ (e.g. immich.svg), OR a name from https://dashboard-icons.dev (e.g. portainer), OR an image URL.
container: the container_name. Adds the live status dot plus Start/Stop buttons (they act on the whole compose stack).
check: an address inside npm_network (usually the NPM target) the dashboard tries, to know when the app is really ready.
ondemand: true = normally off: shown grey instead of red when stopped. nostop: true = hide the Stop button.

update: true = Start first pulls the newest image and recreates the stack (docker compose pull + up -d), e.g. for apps that must stay current like MeTube/yt-dlp. Offline: starts the version already there.
warn: text shown in the Start dialog. stopWarn: text shown in the Stop dialog. busy: where to ask if jobs are running before Stop.
Entries with custom: true were added from the page and can be removed there (Edit button).
